explanation: At most ten was a ceiling, not a requirement. Existing policy supplied four proposals, fixed in plan before outcomes. 5 cases x 3 seeds x 4 = 60 per method; all slots ran; no discovery-based stopping or time truncation.
fairness_defect: Equal calls but asymmetric no-op coverage: deterministic had 15 zero-perturbation baseline repetitions, random had zero. Nonzero perturbation counts were 45 versus 60. Deterministic first-discovery index one was guaranteed by already-wrong baselines; it is not evidence of search value or a perturbation-induced failure. Previous pilot remains unchanged.

prior_pilot_baseline_compatibility.reuse_decision: Freshly evaluate all selected cases once; do not include prior baseline outcomes in new counts.
